actions.text: # Papel de parede -- written by Genesi Store. # hyprlock's own format; edit freely, the store keeps a copy of what was here. general { hide_cursor = true grace = 0 no_fade_in = false } background { monitor = path = screenshot blur_passes = 3 blur_size = 8 brightness = 0.7 contrast = 1.0 vibrancy = 0.17 } input-field { monitor = size = 320, 52 outline_thickness = 2 dots_size = 0.24 dots_spacing = 0.3 dots_center = true outer_color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 0.9) inner_color = rgba(20, 28, 24, 0.75) font_color = rgba(233, 245, 238, 1.0) fade_on_empty = false placeholder_text = senha hide_input = false rounding = 14 position = 0, -90 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $TIME font_size = 96 font_family = Rubik color = rgba(233, 245, 238, 0.95) position = 0, 160 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $USER font_size = 16 font_family = Rubik color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 0.85) position = 0, 96 halign = center valign = center }

actions.text: # Noite -- written by Genesi Store. # hyprlock's own format; edit freely, the store keeps a copy of what was here. general { hide_cursor = true grace = 0 no_fade_in = false } background { monitor = path = screenshot blur_passes = 4 blur_size = 10 brightness = 0.35 contrast = 1.0 vibrancy = 0.17 } input-field { monitor = size = 320, 52 outline_thickness = 2 dots_size = 0.24 dots_spacing = 0.3 dots_center = true outer_color = rgba(120, 160, 140, 0.7) inner_color = rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85) font_color = rgba(200, 220, 208, 1.0) fade_on_empty = false placeholder_text = senha hide_input = false rounding = 20 position = 0, -90 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $TIME font_size = 84 font_family = Rubik color = rgba(200, 220, 208, 0.9) position = 0, 160 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $TIME font_size = 16 font_family = Rubik color = rgba(120, 160, 140, 0.7) position = 0, 96 halign = center valign = center }

actions.text: # Terminal -- written by Genesi Store. # hyprlock's own format; edit freely, the store keeps a copy of what was here. general { hide_cursor = true grace = 0 no_fade_in = false } background { monitor = path = screenshot blur_passes = 1 blur_size = 4 brightness = 0.5 contrast = 1.0 vibrancy = 0.17 } input-field { monitor = size = 320, 52 outline_thickness = 2 dots_size = 0.24 dots_spacing = 0.3 dots_center = true outer_color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 1.0) inner_color = rgba(10, 14, 12, 0.9) font_color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 1.0) fade_on_empty = false placeholder_text = login: hide_input = false rounding = 2 position = 0, -90 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $TIME font_size = 72 font_family = CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 1.0) position = 0, 160 halign = center valign = center } label { monitor = text = $USER@$(hostname) font_size = 16 font_family = CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font color = rgba(143, 214, 171, 0.7) position = 0, 96 halign = center valign = center }
